alt: A small warm Pyongyang room at night: old Yeon sits dying in the chair, three sons standing in the lamp, five crow swords on the wall behind him.
scene: INTIMATE night interior, low three-quarter from the packed-earth floor. ONE DEVICE: a heavy timber chair on axis, FIVE straight Korean ring-pommel swords hung on the wall behind it like a dark comb. SMALL warm Pyongyang timber room — red pillars, lime plaster, one iron lamp on the floor at the LEFT of the lens raking up. OLD Yeon Gesomun (LEFT of the sheet, iron-grey hair, grey beard, NEVER the young black-haired face) sits the chair in a charcoal inner robe and red sash, NO armor, NO five swords on his back, sitting UP, glaring, dying and refusing to lie down. Three sons standing in the midground, ONE OF EACH, never cloned: SECOND = Namseng closest to the chair (tight bun, two short temple-strands, neat goatee, rigid, charcoal court po, red scarf knot, NO helm, NO long hair). THIRD = Namgun (LONG loose black hair past the shoulders, fuller beard, louder stance). FOURTH = Namsan (rounder younger face, looking aside, NO helm). #d0362f as the lamp key on old Yeon's cheek, not a glow. Composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge.
